f.title: Classify serious adverse events by the resolution's seriousness criteria
f.statement: For reporting under this resolution, a serious adverse event or serious adverse drug reaction is any untoward occurrence that at any dose results in death; is life-threatening, requires hospitalisation or prolongs existing hospitalisation; or results in persistent or significant disability/incapacity, or is a congenital anomaly/birth defect. All other adverse events are non-serious.
f.processes: Clinical safety monitoring; Case processing & follow-up

rows.quote: Evento Adverso Serio (EAS) o Reacción Adversa Medicamentosa Seria (RAM Seria): Cualquier ocurrencia desfavorable que a cualquier dosis: a) Resulta en fallecimiento; b) Amenaza la vida, requiere hospitalización del paciente o prolongación de la hospitalización existente; c) Da como resultado incapacidad/invalidez persistente o significativa, o es una anomalía congénita/defecto de nacimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: binding definition that determines which cases follow the expedited route; note that "medically important" is not among the criteria. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: definition row, 86.
rows.quote_en: Serious Adverse Event (SAE) or Serious Adverse Drug Reaction (serious ADR): Any untoward occurrence that at any dose: a) Results in death; b) Is life-threatening, requires hospitalisation of the patient or prolongation of existing hospitalisation; c) Results in persistent or significant incapacity/disability, or is a congenital anomaly/birth defect.

f.title: Submit the investigator's brochure to INVIMA at least annually
f.statement: The investigator's brochure (compilation of clinical and non-clinical data on the investigational products) must be submitted to INVIMA at least once a year, or earlier if the protocol lasts less than one year.

rows.deadline: At least annually (earlier if protocol lasts under one year)
rows.quote: Este documento deberá presentarse al Invima por lo menos una vez al año o antes si la duración del protocolo de investigación es menor a un año.
rows.review_note: Review: obligation embedded in a definition; actor (sponsor) inferred from Art. 4-5. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: This document shall be submitted to INVIMA at least once a year or earlier if the duration of the research protocol is less than one year.

f.title: Report all SAEs to the sponsor and ethics committee within 24 hours
f.statement: The investigator must report all serious adverse events to the sponsor and to the research ethics committee no later than 24 hours after becoming aware of the event, keeping the information confidential.
f.clause: Artículo 3o. Reporte de eventos adversos serios nacionales

rows.quote: El investigador debe reportar al Patrocinador y al Comité de Ética en Investigación todos los eventos adversos serios, en un plazo no mayor de 24 horas luego de conocida la ocurrencia del evento, manteniendo confidencialidad de la información.
rows.location: Artículo 3o. Reporte de eventos adversos serios nacionales
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The investigator must report to the Sponsor and to the Research Ethics Committee all serious adverse events within no more than 24 hours after the occurrence of the event becomes known, maintaining the confidentiality of the information.

deadline_rule.clock_start: luego de conocida la ocurrencia del evento
deadline_rule.applies_to: all serious adverse events at Colombian sites (investigator to sponsor and EC)

f.title: Send SAE follow-up reports until the final outcome
f.statement: The investigator must send detailed follow-up reports on serious adverse events, informing the sponsor and the research ethics committee of the subject's situation until the final outcome of the serious adverse event.

rows.quote: El investigador realizará reportes de seguimiento de eventos adversos serios detallados informando la situación del sujeto participante al patrocinador y al Comité de Ética de Investigación hasta el desenlace final del evento adverso serio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The investigator shall make detailed follow-up reports of serious adverse events informing the sponsor and the Research Ethics Committee of the situation of the participating subject until the final outcome of the serious adverse event.

f.title: Report domestic SAEs to INVIMA within 7 business days of the investigator's first report
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must report each serious adverse event to INVIMA's Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products within seven (7) business days of the investigator's first report, as INVIMA establishes.

rows.deadline: 7 business days from the investigator's first report
rows.quote: El patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), reportará a la Subdirección de Medicamentos y Productos Biológicos del Invima, el evento adverso serio en un plazo no mayor a siete (7) días hábiles a partir del primer reporte realizado por el investigador, tal como lo establezca la Entidad.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall report the serious adverse event to the Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products of INVIMA within no more than seven (7) business days from the first report made by the investigator, as the Entity establishes.

deadline_rule.clock_start: a partir del primer reporte realizado por el investigador
deadline_rule.applies_to: serious adverse events at Colombian sites

f.title: Send SAE follow-up to INVIMA within 15 business days of the initial investigator report
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must prepare a follow-up report on the serious adverse event and submit it to INVIMA within fifteen (15) business days following the investigator's initial report.

rows.deadline: 15 business days from the investigator's initial report
rows.quote: El patrocinador u Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), elaborará un reporte de seguimiento sobre el evento adverso serio que deberá presentarse al Invima dentro de los quince (15) días hábiles siguientes al reporte inicial del investigador.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall prepare a follow-up report on the serious adverse event, which shall be submitted to INVIMA within the fifteen (15) business days following the investigator's initial report.

deadline_rule.clock_start: siguientes al reporte inicial del investigador
deadline_rule.applies_to: follow-up report on domestic serious adverse events

f.title: Send the SAE final outcome report in INVIMA's format
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must also send the final outcome report of the serious adverse event in the format defined by INVIMA.

rows.quote: Así mismo deberá enviarse el reporte de desenlace final del evento adverso serio en el formato definido por la Institución.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Likewise, the final outcome report of the serious adverse event shall be sent in the format defined by the Institution.

f.title: Report non-serious AEs to the sponsor as the protocol specifies
f.statement: The investigator must report national and international non-serious adverse events to the sponsor or CRO in the way set out in the research protocol.
f.clause: Artículo 4o. Reporte de eventos adversos no serios nacionales e internacionales

rows.quote: El investigador debe reportar al patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), los eventos adversos no serios nacionales e internacionales en la forma establecida en el protocolo de investigación.
rows.location: Artículo 4o. Reporte de eventos adversos no serios nacionales e internacionales
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The investigator must report to the sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) national and international non-serious adverse events in the manner established in the research protocol.

f.title: Report non-serious AEs through the annual investigator's brochure
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must report national and international non-serious adverse events through the investigator's brochure, submitted to INVIMA and the research ethics committees annually from the start to the end of the clinical study, or when the health authority or the ethics committees request it, without prejudice to INVIMA's requests at any time.

rows.deadline: Annually, from study start to end, or on request
rows.quote: El patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), reportará los eventos adversos no serios nacionales e internacionales ocurridos, a través del Manual del Investigador, que se presentará al Invima y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación anualmente desde el inicio y hasta la finalización del estudio clínico o cuando lo solicite la autoridad sanitaria o los Comités de Ética en Investigación
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall report the national and international non-serious adverse events that have occurred through the Investigator's Brochure, which shall be submitted to INVIMA and to the Research Ethics Committees annually from the start until the end of the clinical study or when requested by the health authority or the Research Ethics Committees

f.title: Report expected international SAEs through the investigator's brochure
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must report all expected international serious adverse events through the investigator's brochure submitted to INVIMA and the research ethics committees annually, or earlier if the protocol lasts less than one year.
f.clause: Artículo 5o. Reporte de eventos adversos serios internacionales, literal a)
f.applicability: Expected serious adverse events from other countries

rows.deadline: Annually (earlier if protocol lasts under one year)
rows.quote: El patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), reportará todos los eventos adversos serios internacionales esperados, a través del, Manual del Investigador que se presentará al Invima y a los Comités de Ética en Investigación anualmente o antes si la duración del protocolo de investigación es inferior a un (1) año;
rows.location: Artículo 5o. Reporte de eventos adversos serios internacionales, literal a)
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall report all expected international serious adverse events through the Investigator's Brochure, which shall be submitted to INVIMA and to the Research Ethics Committees annually or earlier if the duration of the research protocol is less than one (1) year;

f.title: Send unexpected related foreign SAEs to Colombian investigators within 20 business days
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must send the investigator in Colombia the international serious adverse events that are unexpected and related to the investigational molecule within twenty (20) business days of becoming aware of them.

rows.quote: El patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC) de un protocolo de investigación, enviará al investigador en Colombia los eventos adversos serios internacionales no esperados y relacionados con la molécula en investigación, dentro de los veinte (20) días hábiles siguientes a su conocimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) of a research protocol shall send to the investigator in Colombia the unexpected international serious adverse events related to the investigational molecule within the twenty (20) business days following its knowledge of them.

deadline_rule.applies_to: unexpected related international SAEs (to Colombian investigators)

f.title: Report unexpected related foreign SAEs to the ethics committee within 15 business days
f.statement: The principal investigator in Colombia must report these unexpected related international serious adverse events to the research ethics committee within fifteen (15) business days of becoming aware of them.

rows.quote: A su vez el investigador principal en Colombia, reportará al Comité de Ética en Investigación estos eventos dentro de los quince (15) días hábiles a partir de su conocimiento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In turn, the principal investigator in Colombia shall report these events to the Research Ethics Committee within fifteen (15) business days from becoming aware of them.

deadline_rule.applies_to: unexpected related international SAEs (investigator to EC)

f.title: Report unexpected related foreign SAEs to INVIMA every two months
f.statement: The sponsor or CRO must report the international serious adverse events that are unexpected and related to the investigational molecule to INVIMA's Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products every two (2) months, as INVIMA determines.
f.applicability: Unexpected international SAEs related to the investigational molecule

rows.quote: El patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), reportará los eventos adversos serios internacionales no esperados y relacionados con la molécula en investigación cada dos (2) meses a la Subdirección de Medicamentos y Productos Biológicos, tal como lo determine la entidad.
rows.review_note: Review: periodic line-listing interval, no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: reportará = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall report the unexpected international serious adverse events related to the investigational molecule every two (2) months to the Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products, as the entity determines.

f.title: Submit an annual safety report on the investigational medicine
f.statement: In addition to adverse event notification, clinical study sponsors must send INVIMA's Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products an annual safety report evaluating the safety of the investigational medicine in the light of all information available through the investigator's brochure.

rows.quote: Adicionalmente a la notificación de los eventos adversos, los patrocinadores de estudios clínicos enviarán a la Subdirección de Medicamentos y Productos Biológicos un informe de seguridad anual en el que se evalúe la seguridad del medicamento en investigación teniendo en cuenta toda la información disponible a través del manual del investigador.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In addition to the notification of adverse events, clinical study sponsors shall send to the Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products an annual safety report evaluating the safety of the investigational medicine taking into account all the information available through the investigator's brochure.

f.title: Submit an extraordinary safety report within 5 calendar days
f.statement: Regardless of the annual periodicity, the sponsor or CRO must submit an extraordinary safety report to the research ethics committee and INVIMA when it becomes aware of a situation that endangers the integrity of trial subjects or a health alert arises on the study molecule, within at most five (5) calendar days of becoming aware of the situation.
f.clause: Artículo 6o, Parágrafo. Informes de seguridad extraordinarios

rows.deadline: 5 calendar days from awareness of the situation
rows.quote: el patrocinador o la Organización de Investigación por Contrato (OIC), presentará al Comité de Ética en Investigación y a la Subdirección de Medicamentos y Productos Biológicos un informe de seguridad extraordinario cuando se tenga conocimiento de una situación que ponga en riesgo la integridad de los sujetos participantes en investigación, o se genere una alerta sanitaria sobre la molécula objeto de estudio. Dicho informe, deberá ser presentado en un plazo máximo de cinco (5) días calendario contados a partir de que se tenga conocimiento de la situación.
rows.location: Artículo 6o, Parágrafo. Informes de seguridad extraordinarios
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: the sponsor or the Contract Research Organisation (CRO) shall submit to the Research Ethics Committee and to the Sub-directorate of Medicines and Biological Products an extraordinary safety report when it becomes aware of a situation that endangers the integrity of the research subjects, or a health alert is generated on the molecule under study. This report shall be submitted within a maximum of five (5) calendar days counted from becoming aware of the situation.

deadline_rule.clock_start: contados a partir de que se tenga conocimiento de la situación
deadline_rule.applies_to: extraordinary safety reports (risk to subjects or health alert on the molecule)
